description: When you're acting autonomously for the user and hit a decision you shouldn't make alone, escalate it to them live instead of guessing. Runs the consultation and, only if the signal is blocking (escalate/clarify), wakes the user's phone for an approve/deny/modify. Returns a request_id immediately — then poll phaedo_escalation_status and DO NOT PROCEED until it resolves (if the user doesn't answer in time, hold). Use for consequential, hard-to-undo actions.

action_binding.description: Binds this consultation to the concrete call it describes. The action_descriptor is your ACCOUNT of the action; this is the action. Recorded on the audit receipt so a later mismatch is provable, shown to the subject when an escalation reaches their phone, and REQUIRED by any standing rule the subject marked require_binding before it will auto-proceed.

arguments_hash.description: Hex or base64url digest over the RFC 8785 canonical form of the arguments. Never the arguments themselves.

arguments_preview.description: Optional short human-readable summary of the arguments, shown to the subject on an escalation.

tool_name.description: The tool/function the agent is about to invoke.

name: phaedo_escalate
title: Escalate a blocking decision to the subject in real time
